articles.title: Orcas Are Bumping Boats — And Scientists Think It's Playtime!
articles.summary: A small group of orcas near Spain and Portugal keeps bumping into sailboats — and even sank one in July 2026. Scientists think the whales might just be playing, or practicing their hunting skills. The two people on the sunken boat were rescued safely.

articles.title: Keith Richards Rocks a 65-Year-Old Blues Song for Grand Theft Auto VI
articles.summary: Rolling Stones guitarist Keith Richards recorded a new version of the 1961 blues song "Bright Lights, Big City" for the Grand Theft Auto VI soundtrack. The album has 34 songs and comes out November 19. Richards has been on a solo roll lately.

articles.title: Earth: The Only Planet With Pizza (and You!)
articles.summary: Earth is the only planet we know that has life — from tiny amoebas to giant blue whales to you. It's the third rock from the sun, with just the right temperature for liquid water. Scientists know more about the moon's surface than our own ocean floors.
